result.title: Generalist Meets Specialists: An Evolving Multimodal Agent with Persistent Tool Orchestration for Traffic Scenario Understanding
result.summary: Traffic scenario understanding requires combining fine-grained visual evidence with spatial and temporal reasoning. Tool-augmented vision-language models (VLMs) can use specialized perception tools, but effective collaboration faces two challenges: terminal rewards provide limited guidance for intermediate decisions and error recovery, while repeated planning adds unnecessary cost across similar tasks. Echoing the fast-slow dichotomy of human cognition, we propose StarTV-Agent, which combines policy learning with experience evolution to support adaptive reasoning when needed and efficient reuse of prior experience when possible. During training, Role-Sensitive Process Optimization (RSPO) combines process advantages with terminal advantages, while Weakness-Driven Demonstration Learning (WDL) provides validated teacher demonstrations targeting the student's weak questions. During inference, Lightweight Adaptive Workflow Reuse (LAWR) enables a fast path by selecting suitable workflows and binding task-specific arguments and resource references, while a slow ReAct-based path handles tasks without suitable workflows. We further design label-free feedback based on execution completion, workflow adoption, and cost savings to guide workflow reuse and memory updates. Across three challenging benchmarks, StarTV-Agent achieves up to 8.0% relative performance improvement, while reducing token consumption by up to 52.1%.

AI.brief_summary: 提出面向交通场景理解的多模态 agent StarTV-Agent，用角色敏感的过程优化配合弱项驱动的教师示范训练，并在推理期以工作流复用走快路径、以 ReAct 慢路径处理新任务，结合无标注反馈更新记忆，在三个基准上提升性能并降低 token 消耗。
AI.relevance_reason: 过程优势与终止奖励的结合、快慢双路径的选择与工作流复用，可为核查多模态推理中贡献分配、计算开销与「何时复用而非重新推理」的停止决策提供方法线索，但其收益基于外部工具编排而非内部 latent 状态，与 latent 表示层面的联系仍需阅读正文确认。
